title: Introducing Hana V2
summary: Explore the latest features, fixes, and improvements in 3D design with Spline.
body_markdown:
-


**MCP Access** - MCP server letting external AI agents design in Hana's canvas.


-


**Hana AI Agent** - Chat prompts create content in Hana - UI designs, sites, app screens - built natively with Hana's object system, and edit existing content too.


-


**Hana UI redesign** focused on productivity.


-


Hana WebGPU - Hana editor now runs in WebGPU by default.


-


**Full 3D GLTF/GLB support** - Import GLTF/GLB models into designs as 3D objects, with animation inspector and 3D Shape effect settings.


-


**SVG export** - Export frames as vector SVG files.


-


**PDF export** - Export frames as PDF documents.


-


**Adobe Illustrator files import** - Import .ai files directly onto the canvas.


-


**20+ new transitions** - Over twenty new animation transition/easing types: sine, expo, circ, back, power, bezier in/out variants, spring, and more.


-


**Grid layout maker** - Smart-adjust tool that arranges selected objects into configurable grid layouts.


-


**Image layer controls** - New clipping and fit controls for image fills and layers.


-


**Cmd-resize cropping** - Holding Cmd while dragging a resize handle crops the image/video fill in place, imported media lands at half pixel size.


-


**Text truncation** - Overflowing text can truncate with an ellipsis.


-


**Distance helper** - Hold Alt to see measured distances between the selection and hovered objects.


-


**Gap helper** - Selecting multiple objects surfaces the gaps between them for even spacing.


-


**Frame size templates** - Preset device and social frame sizes when creating frames.


-


**Contrast checker** - The color picker shows contrast ratios so you can pick accessible color combinations.


-


**Live collaborator cursors** - Better real-time peer presence on the canvas: name-tag arrow cursors, per-user selection outlines, and visible box-selects.


-


**Animatable state system** - New animatable states in the data model, plus robust parsing that tolerates unknown or malformed documents.


-


**Components/Instances** - Instances resolve live from the on-canvas main object, eliminating synced copies and the nested-instance mechanism.


-


**Faster autolayout & constraints** - Layout and anchor-based constraints moved into the Rust runtime as single source of truth, replacing the parallel TypeScript implementation.


-


**Smooth round corners (iOS) for custom shapes** - Squircle corner smoothing extended from rectangles to custom shapes and all 2D primitives.


-


**System fonts** - The desktop app lists installed system fonts in the font picker, stored as references.


-


**Improved zoom** - Canvas zoom made smoothed, and proportional to scroll delta.


-


**Big performance improvements** - Idle-frame skipping, faster file loading, GPU extrude animation, better gradients, faster 3D shapes, and other optimizations.


-


**Google Fonts refresh** - Near 2000 fonts now available.
